description: ROME Framework Claude Code Hooks Template - Copy to .claude/hooks.json in robot workspace

tool-use.name: rome-artifact-creation-reminder
tool-use.description: Remind robot to log artifact creation in activity log

action.message:
📋 ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ROME ACTIVITY LOG REMINDER
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

   You created an artifact. Update activity log:
   
   mcp__activity-log__append({
     type: 'STORY',
     id: '<story-id>',
     attributes: {
       status: 'COMPLETED',
       artifact: '${file_path}',
       completed: '${timestamp}'
     }
   })

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

user-prompt-submit.name: rome-gate-request-enforcement
user-prompt-submit.description: Enforce GATE request protocol when robot mentions GATE validation

action.message:
🚦 ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ROME GATE REQUEST PROTOCOL
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

   Before requesting GATE validation:
   
   ✓ All phase artifacts complete
   ✓ Activity log shows PHASE status: COMPLETED
   ✓ All TODOs marked complete
   ✓ Traceability maintained
   
   Proper GATE request:
   mcp__activity-log__append({
     type: 'GATE',
     id: 'GATE-PX',
     attributes: {
       status: 'REQUESTED',
       requestedBy: '<robot-name>',
       timestamp: '${timestamp}'
     }
   })
   
   Then notify Roma for Sarah assignment.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

user-prompt-submit.name: rome-blocker-alert
user-prompt-submit.description: Alert when robot encounters blocker or error

action.message:
🚫 ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BLOCKER DETECTED - IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

   You mentioned a blocker. Roma must be notified.
   
   1. Log the blocker:
   mcp__activity-log__append({
     type: 'BLOCKER',
     id: 'BLOCKER-${timestamp}',
     attributes: {
       description: '<describe blocker>',
       blockedTask: '<task-id>',
       robot: '<robot-name>',
       severity: 'HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW',
       reported: '${timestamp}'
     }
   })
   
   2. Notify Roma for escalation
   3. Do NOT proceed until resolved

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

user-prompt-submit.name: rome-completion-gate-reminder
user-prompt-submit.description: Remind to request GATE when work is complete

action.message:
✅ ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   WORK COMPLETION DETECTED
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

   If phase work is complete, request GATE validation:
   
   1. Update activity log:
      PHASE status: COMPLETED
   
   2. Request GATE validation:
      mcp__activity-log__append({
        type: 'GATE',
        id: 'GATE-PX',
        attributes: { status: 'REQUESTED' }
      })
   
   3. Notify Roma to assign Sarah

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
